g.text: Uniswap v4: pool authority moved to a hash-based key
Three hooks · Uniswap's own v4 on Sepolia, and the EIP-8141 devnet · a hook's callbacks are the low 14 bits of its address
any other contract counts as itself
the whole swap or liquidity change reverts
yes → it runs as in a hookless pool
the pool's own 0.30% fee, amounts untouched
no afterSwap (bit 6 = 0): the gate runs before the pool moves, and nothing needs doing after a swap
PQGuardHook (Sepolia) · FLAGS 0xB01 · a FORS+C second factor for any LP
another key's signature, or the real one
The flags are the address. PoolManager reads its low 14 bits: 0x…4aa0 & 0x3fff = 0x0aa0 · 0x…4b01 & 0x3fff = 0x0b01.
Salts mined for the CREATE2 deployer 0x4e59…956c; each constructor reverts WrongHookAddress() if its bits differ.
